description: Render text-card images (1080x1440 PNG, RedNote's 3:4) on this computer, for notes without photos. Never touches RedNote. Returns absolute paths to pass as images to rednote_create_post. Card 1 is the cover: a short title (use \n to break a Chinese title where it reads best) and 0 to 2 lines; later cards carry up to 8 short lines.

theme.description: one of: notebook, sticky, chalkboard, blueprint

name: rednote_make_cards
